family_reports.body: This system took me away from my four-year-old son on his birthday and my one-year-old-infant based on allegations the court itself later rejected. One hundred and twenty-eight days later, my boys remain without their father — not because of any finding of harm, but because in a high-net-worth divorce the legal process itself, asymmetrically applied, became the instrument of our separation.
They have taken my daughter childhood and my happiness and life from me only because I fought against abuse, this demonic system must end. Now!!!
